observed_outcome: Formal 600s measurement run on PostgreSQL 18.6 processed 120,283 events across 20 streams with 4 producers and 2 relays. All correctness checks PASSED under load (0 lost, 0 duplicates, strictly contiguous per-stream offsets, 20/20 full rebuild projection state hash parity). However, sustained throughput degraded after 100s from 204 events/s down to a worst 10s window of 50.00 events/s (below the >= 200.0 events/s threshold). Root cause identified as sequential scan on outbox table during relay polling due to missing composite index (tenant_id, stream_id, id) and WAL fsync write amplification. Recorded in ISS-024.
